newsitem.title: INDIA: India TELCO down 4 pct on Bombay bourse.
newsitem.headline: India TELCO down 4 pct on Bombay bourse.

text.p: Shares of Indian truckmaker TELCO slid 13.75 rupees or 4.01 percent to 323 rupees in early trade on the Bombay bourse, traders said.

Auto firms TELCO, Bajaj Auto and Mahindra & Mahindra have been pounded lower in the last couple of weeks as some securities firms recommended investors underweight the sector on fears of a prolonged slowdown in the economy.
India's industrial production growth fell to 4.8 percent in April-September 1996 from 12.8 percent a year ago, according to government data released last week.
M&M shares fell 12 rupees or 4.18 percent to 275 and Bajaj Auto dropped 26.75 rupees or 3.13 percent to 828.50.
